title: Interest treasury confirmation succeeded
description: This event occurs when the treasury confirmation step of the closing process is completed with product interest management. Pending assets are activated and the operation date advances to the next business day.

external_operation_id.title: External operation ID
external_operation_id.description: Identifier sent by the client in the external_id field of the treasury confirmation request.

operation_date.title: Operation date
operation_date.description: Operation date, represents the day being closed.
